decisive_check.finding: The exact registered quote includes a line-ending hyphen followed by newline in “farmer-\\nbaker”. The local quote matcher normalizes the source line-break hyphen to a sentinel but normalizes the quote to a hyphen plus space, so its matcher rejects a verbatim quote. This is a deterministic quote-normalization defect in the binder path, not source absence, academic construction, or transport.

gemini.concern: The number of locations with entries does not establish whether the entries themselves were made with care.

dataset_construction_review.diagnosis: This fixture does not distinguish quantity/distribution (sparse) from recording care (meticulous); both properties can hold for the same entries. Luna’s unresolved-rival rejection is academically justified. Gemini’s contradiction of meticulous is unsupported by the stated facts. This is a construction/label issue despite the frozen positive label; the label/outcome remains unchanged and the item remains in the denominator.

corrected_cross_case_conclusion: For the 11 academically supported controls, Luna/OpenAI’s challenge array consistently contains the selected answer A and omits nonchosen option D; its four-row option-resolution matrix passes in all 11. Gemini matrices pass in 9 and are rejected for the two distinct evidence-binding representations documented above. Luna’s CUET-fit is below the gate in 10/11; the remaining control scores 10. Thus the widespread Luna pattern is explained by challenge-schema/prompt semantics and omitted canonical CUET-fit anchors; two additional Gemini rows show independent representation-level failures. No source or transport failure was established for these 11. The single English construction/label defect is separate. All selected cases stopped before explanation_support; no explanation-defect audit was executed.
